top10.readme:
# 词光 · Word Atlas
**把单词变成画面，让复习有迹可循。**
7,298 个雅思词条 · 原创插画 · 英美发音 · FSRS 间隔复习
[**立即体验 ↗**](https://0xlei.tech/words/)　 /　 [48 秒介绍](docs/assets/launch.mp4)　 /　 [下载词库](data/)　 /　 [English](README.en.md)
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](CONTENT_LICENSE.md)
**词光 iOS App 已在 App Store 上架，免费下载：[App Store · 搜索「词光」](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827459612)**
[ ](https://x.com/yangleiocx3)
---
词光是一款以插画和语境为核心的雅思背词应用。看画面理解词义，听发音建立联系，再用主动回忆和间隔复习巩固记忆。无需账号，学习进度保存在自己的设备上。
> **版本说明**：这个仓库提供词光的开源基础版及配套数据集。在线网站独立迭代，功能与仓库可能不同；仓库里的代码和内容分别遵循下方的 MIT / CC BY 4.0 授权。
[产品预览](#产品预览) · [学习方式](#学习方式) · [本地运行](#本地运行) · [开放数据](#开放数据) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献)
## 产品预览
### 一本可以听、可以练的单词图鉴
  每日计划，把注意力放在今天  插画、词义、发音，在一张词卡里  
 以上为仓库开源版的实际界面。页首为品牌概念插画。 
### 学过的词，汇成自己的星图
19 个话题组成词汇星图。拖动旋转、滚动缩放，点击星星打开词卡；学习状态用不同亮度呈现。采用 WebGL2 渲染，不支持的设备提供降级显示。
  看 48 秒宣传片  
[播放完整视频（含声音）](docs/assets/launch.mp4)
## 学习方式
| 环节 | 你会做什么 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **看见** | 每个词配一幅插画、中英释义、两条原创例句，以及搭配、词族和用法提示。 |
| **听见** | 切换英音、美音，听日常例句朗读；部分词条另含第二条例句录音。 |
| **想起** | 看义选词、看图补句、听音辨词、拼写，逐步练习主动回忆。 |
| **复习** | FSRS 根据学习记录安排复习，目标记忆率可调。只有首次作答计入正确率。 |
| **积累** | 星图展示学习进度；打字练习独立统计；支持导出和恢复本地进度。 |
**本地优先。** 无需注册；看过的词条与媒体可缓存供离线使用。换设备前，请先导出进度备份。
  听发音、例句与环境声样本  
拿 *abandon* 举例，点开就能听（在线播放）：
| | |
|---|---|
| 🇬🇧 英音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/uk/abandon.mp3) |
| 🇺🇸 美音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/us/abandon.mp3) |
| 📖 例句朗读 | [We had to abandon our car in the snow.](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/ex/abandon.mp3) |
全部 7,298 个词都有英音、美音和例句朗读，还有 1,011 个重点词的第二条例句也配了朗读。
### 环境声与交互声音
| | |
|---|---|
| 🎙 **开屏配音** | [「欢迎打开雅思大门」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/splash-voice.mp3)：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开 |
| 🌌 **星图配音** | [「这是你的词汇星图。每学会一个词，就点亮一颗星。」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/voice-galaxy-hello.mp3) |
| 🎵 **星空音乐** | [一段可无缝循环的原创配乐](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-stars.mp3)，默认陪你背词 |
| 🌧 **6 段环境声** | [雨天图书馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-rain.mp3) · [清晨海岸](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-sea.mp3) · [林间早晨](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-forest.mp3) · [夜晚壁炉](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-fire.mp3) · [远航船舱](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-voyage.mp3) · [安静咖啡馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-cafe.mp3) |
| ✨ **界面音效** | 答对、答错、翻卡、打字、连胜、点亮星星……每个操作都有自己的声音；读单词时背景音会自动压低 |
全部素材都在仓库里：插画在 `public/atlas/img/`，录音在 `public/atlas/audio/`，这两类按 CC BY 4.0 开放；界面声音和配乐在 `public/sfx/`，随应用一起提供。
## 本地运行
需要 **Node.js 20+** 和 npm。仓库含完整图片与录音，首次下载可能较久。
```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/designfuchen/word-atlas.git
cd word-atlas
npm ci

A local-first video metadata scraper and media manager.
[Website](https://peach.video) · [Download](#download-and-use) · [Live demo](https://demo.peach.video) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

## Screenshots
[ ](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/home-wide-20261118-2-en.png)
Movie demo data; see [asset credits and licenses](https://peach.video/en/credits/).
 More screenshots 
**People and works**
[ ](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/profile-wide-20261118-2-en.png)
**Creator updates**
[ ](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/follow-wide-20261118-2-en.png)
**Library statistics**
[ ](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/stats-wide-20261118-2-en.png)
**Player**
[ ](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/play-wide-20261118-2-en.png)
## Features
- **Metadata scraping**: recognize video codes, read NFO files and fill titles, performers, studios and covers from multiple sources while keeping your edits.
- **Local and cloud libraries**: browse local drives, SMB, mounted cloud storage and PikPak libraries together.
- **Playback and history**: web and external players, subtitles, playback speed, rotation, resume and timeline previews.
- **Follows and discovery**: track performer and creator updates, discover titles and manage a want list.
- **Cloud download**: search by video code or submit a magnet link, then organize completed downloads into your library.
- **Library management**: manage tags, duplicates, versions and parts; permanently delete videos by performer while keeping profiles and photos. Metadata and watch history are stored locally.
- **Task center**: pause, resume or cancel local background tasks and view their CPU, GPU and download activity where available.

top10.descricao_en: A self-hosted job search and resume builder app that writes tailored resumes and cover letters from your profile.
top10.readme:
Dossier 
  Your job search, on your own server: one profile, a tailored resume and cover letter for every job, and every application tracked from draft to offer.
Dossier keeps your career history in one profile and turns it into a clean resume. For every job you apply to, it reads the posting, shows how you match, and drafts a tailored resume and cover letter that only use facts from your profile. You refine them in a chat, download them as PDFs and track each application from draft to offer.
It's for one person on a small server: one password, your data in your own PostgreSQL database (or a single SQLite file), and an AI model of your choice. That can be a local model through Ollama or LM Studio, so your profile and documents stay on your own hardware, or a hosted one (any OpenAI-compatible API, Anthropic or Mistral), which then receives what it writes from. [Privacy](https://github.com/AienTech/dossier/wiki/Privacy) says what goes where.
**Get started:** [run it on your computer](#run-it-on-your-computer) in a few minutes, or [self-host it](#self-hosting) on a server. The [installation guide](https://github.com/AienTech/dossier/wiki) covers every way: Docker with or without Compose, Node.js, a plain Ubuntu server, CapRover, Coolify and Dokploy.
**Or download the desktop app** for Windows or Linux from the [latest release](https://github.com/AienTech/dossier/releases/latest). It runs Dossier on your computer with nothing else to install, or opens a Dossier you host. See [Desktop app](https://github.com/AienTech/dossier/wiki/Desktop-app).
## Demo
 Recorded with the demo data (Jane Doe is made up) and a stand-in AI server that answers at once, played at 1.2× speed. With a real model, reading a posting and writing the documents takes from a few seconds to a few minutes. 
## Features
- **Profile:** basics, skills and languages, experience and volunteering, projects, education, certifications, publications and references, in the order you choose, with a strength meter that counts only what a profile needs. Projects (side, open-source, course or thesis work) show what you can do where your job titles don't yet. Certifications keep who issued them, their dates, credential ID and a link to verify them. Publications are cited in your own style, with bold and italics, and go on resumes word for word. Start it from an existing resume (PDF, Word or Markdown) if you like.
- **Base resume:** twelve themes and a theme builder, previewed live and printed to PDF on the se

top10.descricao_en: Chain region scanner: find proxy configs that get you into Google AI Studio and Gemini (signed-in browser check, anti-DPI, Windows/macOS/Linux/Android)
top10.readme:
English  ·  فارسی 
# Gemini Config Checker
Find proxy configs that actually get you into **Google AI Studio and Gemini**, by testing each one the way a person would: in a
*signed-in* browser, through the route you will really use.
> **Version 0.1.0, early pre-release.** It works end to end on Windows (the only platform it has been run on so far). The macOS,
> Linux and Android builds come from the CI pipeline and have not been exercised on real devices yet. Please report what you find.
## Two modes, one switch
The big **Simple / Advanced** switch in the header decides what is tested. The route diagram under the title morphs to show it.
| | **Simple** | **Advanced** |
|---|---|---|
| Question it answers | *Which of my configs work?* | *Which free configs work through my config?* |
| Route | you → **config** → AI Studio / Gemini | you → **base config** → **free config** → AI Studio / Gemini |
| You provide | your configs (links, a subscription URL or base64), or pick a ready-made free list | one working base config, plus a free list or pasted configs |
| Anti-DPI profile is applied to | every config under test (each one connects from your machine) | the base config's first hop (free configs run inside its tunnel) |
| Typical use | check a pile of configs you already have; test a config before you rely on it | your Cloudflare config works, but you need a *different exit* that Google accepts |
| Export | links, base64, a full Xray config of one config | links, base64, a chain Xray config (`base → free`) |
## Contents
[Credits](#credits-and-references) · [Why a signed-in browser](#why-a-signed-in-browser) · [Download and install](#download-and-install) ·
[User guide](#user-guide) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting-and-faq) · [Privacy and security](#privacy-and-security) ·
[Build from source](#build-from-source) · [Releases and CI](#releases-and-ci)
## Credits and references
This project exists because of other people's work. Please go and use and star them.
| Project | What it gave us |
|---|---|
| [**0xRadikal/Free-v2ray-Configs**](https://github.com/0xRadikal/Free-v2ray-Configs) | The auto-updated lists of free configs (`verified`, `fast`, `secure`, ...) that this tool scans |
| [**patterniha**](https://github.com/patterniha) | [PattN](https://github.com/patterniha/PattN) (Windows / Linux / macOS client) and [PattNG](https://github.com/patterniha/PattNG) (Android): the anti-DPI recipe, plus the fragment `finalmask` semantics from his [Xray-core fork](https:
